about: Silent differences each bridge still has (spec_inbox/lang/line-numpy-parity-spec.md). test/numpy-parity.test.mjs fails if a bridge has a mismatch NOT listed here, and also if a listed one now matches — remove it when you fix it.

line.red.std.ddof: ddof ignored — population std returned (found by the harness)
line.round.half.even: round half up, numpy rounds half to even (§1)
line.round.half.even.array: round half up, numpy rounds half to even (§1)
line.la.eigh.lower: eigh reads the upper triangle, numpy the lower (§1)
line.la.lstsq.x: lstsq returns the solution, not (x, residuals, rank, s) (§1)
line.la.lstsq.rank: lstsq returns the solution, not (x, residuals, rank, s) (§1)
line.print.str.1d: str/repr print the JS NdArray form (§1)
line.print.repr.1d: str/repr print the JS NdArray form (§1)
line.print.str.2d: str/repr print the JS NdArray form (§1)
line.print.str.frac: str/repr print the JS NdArray form (§1)
line.print.str.bool: str/repr print the JS NdArray form (§1)
line.print.str.arange: str/repr print the JS NdArray form (§1)

natra.red.std.ddof: std(x, ddof=1) returns an array — the keyword is taken as an axis
natra.round.half.even: round half up, numpy rounds half to even
natra.round.half.even.array: round half up, numpy rounds half to even
natra.round.scaled: decimal rounding, numpy scales then rounds half to even (0.125 → 0.12)
natra.round.around: decimal rounding, numpy scales then rounds half to even (1.25 → 1.2)
natra.la.eigh.lower: eigh reads the upper triangle, numpy the lower
natra.stat.corrcoef: corrcoef returns a nested list, not an array
natra.print.str.1d: str prints repr form; floats without the trailing point
natra.print.repr.1d: repr prints floats without the trailing point
natra.print.str.bool: str prints repr form; booleans as 0/1
